style: 16-bit pixel art game art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited night palette: plum black, deep plum, violet glow, cream, sunset orange, warm orange and gold window lights, the career accent colour only on screens and small glows. Dusk City at night: a skyline made of lit window dots, a few still stars
suffix: no people, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no sunburst rays, no perspective floor grid, no scanlines, no grain, no glowing particles

assets.prompt: a city bus stop shelter on a quiet street at night, in the centre a big new route sign on the shelter glowing softly, made only of bright pink colour-coded route stripes, dots and simple arrow shapes, a city bus with lit windows and warm headlights pulling in at the right edge, its destination display dark and blank, the lit city skyline behind

a school canteen at night with food stall counters, hanging lamps and stools in the background, on a table in the centre a giant generic smartphone standing upright, its screen showing a pink wireframe of a food pre-order app: rows of blank food tiles, simple grey bars instead of words, one big plain pink button with nothing written on it, pastel sticky notes stuck around the phone frame, one sticky note with a red circle drawn around a tiny button

an open orange portfolio folder on a desk at night, on its pages two pencil sketches of the same phone screen side by side, the second one simpler with bigger shapes, pink sticky notes and a small pink star sticker on the pages, a pencil beside it, through the window a small cream university gate on a far hill under the moon

a bedroom desk at night under a warm desk lamp, a phone propped on a small stand showing a simple app screen of blank pink tiles, beside it a sheet of paper with a hand-drawn pencil sketch of the same screen redrawn simpler with bigger shapes, a pencil and an eraser, the moon in the window over the lit city, a small orange flag planted beside the paper

a rooftop at the edge of the city just before sunrise, in the centre a whiteboard on an easel covered in a flow of blank boxes joined by pink arrows and a few pink sticky notes, the last arrow leading off the board onto a path of glowing tiles toward a thin orange band of first light on the horizon, a small pink flag at the end of the path
a vertical top-down game world map at night: five small dark islands in a deep plum sea, tiny lit windows on each island, no path, no labels
a chunky pixel picture frame, pink outer border, orange corner studs, deep plum dithered interior with a few stars, empty centre
the PassionSeed flame logo as a pixel game host: yellow flame body, black face, big white eyes, holding a small mic, transparent background
the same flame host, mouth open mid-sentence, transparent background
the same flame host winking, transparent background
the same flame host, flame tips swayed one pixel, transparent background
the same flame host with eyes shut mid blink, transparent background
the same flame host cheering, eyes closed happily, wide grin, transparent background
